panels.headline: Happy Birthday Maya
panels.body: Your support keeps independent work personal, human, and close to home.
panels.art_direction: A soft pastel color palette dominates this cinematic single-object cover. A delicate houseplant in a minimalist white planter takes center stage, with the headline 'Happy Birthday Maya' in a clean sans-serif font at the top and the body 'Wishing you a growth-filled year' in a smaller script font at the bottom. The background is a light beige color with a subtle texture.
